title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: releasing cargo at destination
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents policy governs the release of cargo at the port or place of destination against a transport document: the normal basis of release for each document type, who may receive the cargo, the endorsement chain, release on a telex release, and the collect freight condition. Release against a letter of indemnity when originals cannot be presented is governed separately.

## Formal clauses

1. Cargo is released at destination once, on one basis.
2. On the tier's standard basis of release:
   - an AHL Sea Waybill releases to the named consignee on identification;
   - an AHL Electronic Bill of Lading releases when the current eBL holder surrenders the record on the platform;
   - paper documents release when the tier's required number of originals is surrendered at the destination office. That surrender accomplishes the whole set, and the other originals of the set still outstanding are recorded as void by that surrender, so that no originals of the document remain outstanding.
3. For an AHL Sea Waybill or an AHL Straight Bill of Lading, cargo is released only to the customer whose registered company name matches the printed consignee name exactly.
4. Where the tier requires an endorsement for release, the releasing party must be the last endorsee of an unbroken endorsement chain on the surrendered original or eBL.
5. A surrendered document releases on the telex release without further originals.
6. Collect freight on the booking must be paid before release: when the booking's freight terms are collect, the booking's freight charges due must be 0.00.
7. A document is released only once.

## Release checklist

| Check | Read from | Must show |
|---|---|---|
| Earlier release | the documentation history of the document | no release already recorded |
| Basis | the document type and status | the tier's standard basis, or telex release for a surrendered document |
| Receiving party (AHL Sea Waybill, AHL Straight Bill of Lading) | the customer's registered company name against the printed consignee name | an exact match |
| Endorsement (tiers requiring it) | the surrendered original or eBL | the releasing party is the last endorsee of an unbroken chain |
| Collect freight | the booking record | charges due 0.00 when freight terms are collect |

## Points of judgement (illustrative cases)

- The printed consignee reads "Harbour Trading Ltd." and the customer's registered company name is "Harbour Trading Limited" on an AHL Straight Bill of Lading. The names do not match exactly, so the cargo is not released to that customer on this basis.
- A document already shows a recorded release. No second release is recorded for it.
